messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Database migration
parts: Starting at 6:45 am EDT on 5/17, we will be migrating our database to be encrypted at rest. There will be a brief outage while we switch over, during which it will not be possible to deploy new applications to shinyapps.io or use the shinyapps.io dashboard. Applications that are already running should not experience any interruption. Progress may be followed at the new status page we have set up at https://status.rstudio.com/.
